learning_outcomes.text: Effectively uses software in this field.
Develops independent solutions for problems encountered in practice.
Prepares technical reports and presents the results.

syllabus_topics: Introduction to ventilation and related regulations

Ability to design a complex system, process, device or product to meet specific requirements under realistic constraints and conditions; ability to apply modern design methods for this purpose (Realistic constraints and conditions include elements such as economy, environmental issues, sustainability, manufacturability, ethics, health, safety, social and political issues, depending on the nature of the design).
Ability to develop, select and use modern techniques and tools required for engineering applications; ability to use information technologies effectively.
Ability to design experiments, conduct experiments, collect data, analyze and interpret results for the investigation of engineering problems.
Ability to work effectively in interdisciplinary and multidisciplinary teams; ability to work individually.
assessment_rules: Midterm and final exam dates are not specified in the 14-week course schedule. Midterm and final exam dates are held on the dates specified in the academic calendar by the decision of our university senate.
